submissions.note: # T-squeeze-6: R_SMALL=311 W=21 (deeper W island via 2D R×W sweep)

Implementation notes:
- Default route enables `LOWQ_Q824_REMAINDER_LQ_HIGH_HOST=1`.
- `LOWQ_Q824_COEFFICIENT_LQ_HIGH_HOST` is deliberately left disabled. A one-shot bisection showed that coefficient high-bit hosting causes classical mismatches, while the remainder-only cut validates.
- `LOWQ_Q824_ROTATED_SWAP_LQ_HIGH_HOST` is also left disabled for the submitted route.

This keeps the sub825 target on the verified register-shared EEA implementation and avoids the invalid Q824 coefficient shortcut.
